YouTube Help: Information panel providing publisher context
English Wikipedia article per outlet (see evidence_urls)

_notes: category: state_controlled = owned/operated or editorially controlled by a government or ruling party; state_affiliated = government-sponsored/funded with weaker documented editorial control; public_broadcaster_government_funded = statutory public broadcasters (here India's Prasar Bharati family): government sources, NOT disinformation. Use only as CONTEXT (Appearance.context_flags='state_affiliated'); never as a falsity signal by itself. YouTube's policy (fetched) shows a publisher-context panel when 'a channel is owned by a news publisher that is funded by a government, or publicly funded'. Could not be fetched on 2026-10-31 and therefore NOT cited: EUR-Lex Council Regulation (EU) 2022/350 (HTTP 202 empty bot challenge), Council of the EU press release (HTTP 403), X state-affiliated label policy (HTTP 403), Meta state-controlled media page (404). The EU RT/Sputnik bans are cited via Wikipedia instead. Match on registrable domain incl. subdomains, plus aliases.
